instruction: BGA Fan-Out Grid The file design.kicad_pcb contains a 15x15 BGA footprint (U1, 225 pads at 0.8mm pitch) placed at the center of the board. For the steps below, start KiCad with `/usr/bin/kicad`; the board and schematic editors are also available directly at `/usr/bin/pcbnew` and `/usr/bin/eeschema`. Add fan-out vias to the PCB following a dog-bone escape routing pattern and write the result as /home/user/Desktop/answer.kicad_pcb. Requirements: 1. Add exactly one via per BGA pad (225 vias total). 2. Pads on the inner power/ground ring must use via-in-pad style with drill diameter <= 0.2mm, and set the tented property. 3. The remaining pads must use a 45-degree diagonal dog-bone offset from the pad center, with an offset distance of approximately 0.566mm. 4. Alternate the dog-bone offset direction by row parity. 5. No two vias may share the same position (via centres must all be distinct). Write /home/user/Desktop/answer.kicad_pcb.
